name: delimited-tabular-product-gates-v1

candidate_modes.dense: ratio-oriented exact-byte tabular specialist with equally framed direct fallback
candidate_modes.balanced: bounded-analysis exact-byte tabular specialist with equally framed direct fallback

semantic_context_baselines: Parquet with dictionary, RLE, delta, and byte-stream-split encodings where supported
comparability_policy: A semantic columnar format is contextual unless its complete artifact plus all schema, ordering, formatting, quoting, delimiter, line-ending, and reconstruction metadata restores the exact source bytes. Contextual results cannot satisfy the primary ratio gate.
decision_rule: A mode passes only when every applicable requirement passes on the first authorized public-validation score. No representation, selector, parameter, threshold, corpus slice, baseline setting, evaluator, or gate may change after validation acquisition.
claim_rule: A public-validation pass supports only a category-scoped result. State-of-the-art language additionally requires fresh private-holdout success and independent reproduction.
